text.name: copy / introduction
text.text: Choose features and shortcuts in the picker, then build that exact configuration with the local helper.

text.name: copy / selection / note
text.text: Import the exported configuration or use the choices saved in this browser. Change features and shortcuts in the picker.

text.name: copy / helper / note
text.text: Start the source-only helper on your computer with your official v5.52 firmware and matching installed tools. Paste the connection supplied by that helper. Firmware and compiler inputs stay on your computer.

text.name: copy / receipt / note
text.text: The helper checks the authenticated source transaction. This page checks the canonical selection, configuration and complete candidate bytes before preparing a USB handoff.

text.name: copy / receiptNote
text.text: The helper checks the authenticated source transaction. This page checks the canonical selection, configuration and complete candidate bytes before preparing a USB handoff.

text.name: copy / receiptLimit
text.text: Local JSON receipt plus complete APP1 bytes.

text.name: Receipt status
text.text: No files inspected. Upload remains held.

text.name: copy / handoff / note
text.text: Selected expanded images remain held. Native runtime and physical evidence must match that exact image before any upload can be admitted. A checked source build does not qualify recording into pads or global capture.

text.name: USB held state
text.text: Source and artifact checks do not admit a firmware upload.

text.name: copy / restorationNote
text.text: The byte-identical P6S restoration is a separate release. Its qualified USB path never authorizes a different selected candidate.

text.name: copy / footer
text.text: Local build inspection. Selected-image USB delivery remains held.
